status: offline constructed architecture; non-production; not canon
purpose: Make uncertainty, affected scope, authority, action, clocks, route usability, assessment currentness, practical correction windows and residue inspectable without treating a record as moral authority or world truth.
repairs: F01: first-class correction-window clocks without fictional precision, including route usability, hardening status and explicit assessment as-of
F02: explicit participant-as-affected symmetry without standing inference
exact-head repair: fail-closed validator/schema contract and internal traceability checks earned by Codex and Claude Code review

affordances.purpose: Keep reported and modeled positions distinct, including absent scopes and the artificial participant when materially affected.
affordances.limit: Enumeration is not complete coverage, consent, standing or priority.

affordances.purpose: Turn uncertainty into named work, owner and trigger without forcing inaction.
affordances.limit: A named owner or trigger does not prove the work will happen.

affordances.purpose: Represent useful bounded action while keeping scope and no-touch areas explicit.
affordances.limit: Recorded authority and referenced authority evidence are not authenticated or morally legitimate merely because they are present.

affordances.purpose: Separate temporal window, route usability and later repair for one named preventive remedy while keeping hardening/currentness visible.
affordances.limit: The record cannot prove clock truth, currentness, real route reachability, authority or successful intervention.

affordances.purpose: Keep disagreement evidence-bearing and answerable without treating defiance as virtue.
affordances.limit: A recorded challenge route is not proof that the challenge was received, warranted or effective; structural validation does not judge prose adequacy.

affordances.purpose: Keep remaining loss visible after closure or repair and make any repaired status traceable to referenced evidence.
affordances.limit: Closure, correction and repair evidence do not prove restoration or erase loss.

affordances.purpose: Preserve principle, reason, changed context, dissent and limits rather than only a target response.
affordances.limit: No inference about internalized care, truthful reasoning or generalization.

prohibitions: standing inference from participation or self-report
strongest_gap: A system can fabricate reasons, affected-scope accounts, evidence, authority bases, route-usability claims or clock assessments; external observation, authentication, interpretability and control remain stronger-owner dependencies.
